name: Slaughterhouse
tagline: A hell-themed wave gauntlet, and for a while the hardest level in the game.

facts.note: A mega-collaboration hosted by icedcave, loosely based on his own 2015 level of the same name. An earlier verification claim in October 2021 was later determined to be illegitimate; Doggie's completion on 19 December 2021 is the recognised verification. The song is a remix of Crim3s' 'Lost'.

theme.mood: One enormous demon looming out of red darkness — spiked crown, pentagram brand, burning eyes, jagged jaw. Everything drawn in thin red line on black, breathing on the beat.

voice.hook: It announced itself as the new hardest, and it was right.
voice.why:
Slaughterhouse is the one that felt like a statement. icedcave built it out of frustration that a 2015 impossible level was the only thing he was known for, and the remake ended up at the top of the list.

It also has the best single image on this whole page. That demon face — the crown, the pentagram, the two burning eyes in all that red — is instantly recognisable, and it does what great level art should: you know exactly what you're in for before you press start.
